result.stdout:
Easy Ads Integration Validator

easy-ads-validator scan <project-path> [options]
easy-ads-validator reference scan-max-package <package-or-extracted-dir> --out <directory>

Options:
  --platform <name>                 Default: unity. Public beta supports unity
  --mediation <name>                Default: max. Public beta supports max
  --profile <name>                  Default: max-unity
  --policy <path>                   Optional local JSON policy
  --format <formats>                markdown, json, or markdown,json
  --out <directory>                 Directory for report files
  --fail-on <severity|fail>         Default: fail
  --include-passes                  Include PASS findings
  --report-detail <mode>            compact, standard, or full. Default: compact
  --max-evidence-per-finding <n>    Override evidence cap
  --summary-only                    Emit summary without findings
  --verbose                         Include diagnostics
  --version                         Print version

Maintainer reference options:
  reference scan-max-package         Scan a local official MAX Unity package without network access
  --out <directory>                  Directory for max-sdk-package-reference reports

Examples:
  easy-ads-validator scan .
  easy-ads-validator scan . --platform unity --mediation max
  easy-ads-validator scan . --format json --report-detail compact
  easy-ads-validator scan . --format markdown,json --out audit-report --report-detail full --include-passes
  easy-ads-validator scan . --policy ads-audit.json --fail-on high
  easy-ads-validator reference scan-max-package AppLovin-MAX.unitypackage --out reference-output

Terminal behavior:
  Interactive Markdown scans show progress and can write the report to a prompted output directory.
  JSON stdout and redirected output stay machine-safe and never prompt.
